headline: Blue Origin Delays New Glenn Rocket Launches to January 2027
summary: Blue Origin has announced a delay in the launch schedule for its New Glenn rocket, pushing the timeline to January 2027.
why: Delays in major aerospace development programs can impact long-term revenue projections and investor confidence in private space exploration companies.

impacts.name: Blue Origin
impacts.why: Launch delays postpone potential revenue generation and may signal technical or operational challenges.
